author: smuzaffar
body:
Thsi PR suggest to use `fork` as default method for multiprocess for compare using files script. We noticed that PR comparison jobs are taking too much time  when there are too many differences e.g. for https://github.com/cms-sw/cmsdist/pull/11001 ( where we have updated Vecgeom ) , the comparison job was taking over 20 hours before we killed it. Note that this a a side effect of Python 3.14 which now use `forkserver` as default per multiprocess . There has been reports about his [a].

I tried using `compare_using_files.py` to comapre two root files ( one from IB  and one from Vecgeom PR) and without this change it took 72mins [b] and with this change it took 9mins[c]


[a] https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/139881.
